name: Sync Staleness Watchdog
description: Runs every 6 hours. Checks MAX date on garmin_daily (2 day threshold), strava_activities, and hevy_workouts (72h threshold). Fires ntfy alert only if stale.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  'garmin_daily' AS source,
  MAX(date)::text AS latest_date,
  CASE WHEN MAX(date) < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 days' THEN 25 ELSE 0 END AS hours_since_sync,
  1 AS threshold_hours
FROM garmin_daily
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'strava_activities',
  MAX(activity_date)::date::text,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(updated_at))) / 3600,
  72
FROM strava_activities
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'hevy_workouts',
  MAX(start_time)::date::text,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(updated_at))) / 3600,
  72
FROM hevy_workouts
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'daily_nutrition',
  MAX(date)::text,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(updated_at))) / 3600,
  26
FROM daily_nutrition
